matches.title: Hunter Rework Concept

Not to mention the design is getting quite outdated, given the fact its first rework was back in late 2021. matches.title: Is TDS an analogy for the 2008 housing and economic crisis?
matches.snippet: Is TDS an analogy for the 2008 housing and economic crisis? The 2008 housing and economic crisis was a time period where the housing market bubble popped and caused a recession. Tds is a roblox game. Now on paper these 2 do not have anything in common. However, there are plenty of similarities. Lets start at the beginning: in the 90s the US goverment passed and changed some laws making low income houses more affordable with lower interest rates and such. This allowed for people to make more riskier investments. In 2021 there were only about 8 or so vaible towers in tds. You had accel and gmini for dps. matches.title: Solo Fog trial with Kingpin!
matches.snippet: Solo Fog trial with Kingpin! Saying that it was intense is SAYING NOTHING. I almost died at wave 32, but managed to kill Giant Skeletons and Breakers right near the base 3 TIMES! And the Wave 36 was also terrifying because, i didn't killed Grave Digger at time. Templars were also a problem, though the Boss was underwhelming. Why Kingpin? Because i wanted to challenge myself.
